name: LottieMCU
description: Minimal-footprint Lottie animation player for microcontrollers (ESP32, RP2040, STM32, SAMD). Anti-aliased strip rendering to RGB565 via a callback, so no framebuffer is needed and any display library works. Supports shapes, strokes, gradients, trim paths, repeaters, masks, track mattes and image layers, with optional PSRAM use on ESP32.
keywords: lottie, bodymovin, animation, vector, display, tft, lcd, graphics, rgb565, lvgl, esp32, rp2040
